finding.description: Pause/PDA rebind conflict UI routed through ModalWindow.Show, which silently returns when no modal service is registered. That leaves RebindingManager in pending-conflict IsRebinding state without a visible confirm/cancel owner.

changes: Resolve IModalWindowService through GlobalRegistry.ModalWindow in the cold conflict event path.
If the modal service is absent, invoke the cached cancel callback immediately and write a preallocated status message.
Call IModalWindowService.ShowModal directly so missing service can no longer be hidden by ModalWindow.Show's void/silent-return API.
Removed unreachable LegacyHighRtx switch arms after Normalize() to keep scalability proof literal.
fix.hotPathImpact: none; conflict handling is a cold rebind UI event, not simulation Tick/Update
